what: The middle word of a three-line large title flips through several typefaces and settles on the last one — after .35s the middle frame appears from 1.4× and transparent to 1.2× over 1.2s power3.inOut, and from .6s it changes typeface every .11s (the typeface order repeats 4 times, so with four faces that is 16 changes · 1.76s) and lands on the last. At the landing moment (2.36s with four) fx:done fires, and the frame shrinks to 1× over .64s expo.out, then .3s later steps aside by −.5em over .8s expo.inOut. The top and bottom words sharpen from 30px blur and transparent (top at −30px, bottom at +30px) over 1s power2.out (.05s stagger), then .15s later move into place over .8s expo.out, and the last word opens its right margin to .5em over 1s expo.inOut

options.step: Per-set swap interval (seconds), default .11 — 0 means all at once
options.loops: Number of repeats of the set order, default 4
options.blur: Initial blur of the top and bottom words (px), default 30
options.rise: Initial offset (px) between the upper and lower words, default 30
options.shift: Distance the center frame steps aside after it settles, default -0.5em
options.tail: Right margin after the last word, default 0.5em
options.[data-fx-part=stack]: Center word frame (required) — height is set by the user
options.[data-fx-part=variant]: Typeface sets inside the frame (at least one) — sits on the last set. The consuming css assigns the typeface per set

use: The PatternPatternPattern Atlas
note: With reduced motion, the final round and resting position are placed immediately and fx:done fires right away — the consuming side hangs the remaining entrances such as the header and call card on fx:done (the original removes html.is-intro).

from.where: index.html .ct-title (The·Culture·Index, center word in four typefaces) — original IntroHeroTitle (timeline delay .35, variant .11s × 16, is-intro removed)
